system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS Advanced mathematics test for students in the twelfth grade, the final year of secondary school, who have taken advanced mathematics courses. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
These 2 questions belong together and follow one another in the test booklet.

## Question 1

A. Triangle ABC is reflected in the y-axis. On the diagram, draw and label triangle A'B'C', the image of triangle ABC under this reflection.

[Image: Coordinate grid with triangle ABC]

Figure, described in words:
A Cartesian coordinate grid showing the x-axis and y-axis intersecting at the origin labeled O. The grid extends 5 units to the left, 10 units to the right, 5 units up, and 8 units down. Each grid square represents 1 unit by 1 unit. In the third quadrant, a triangle ABC is drawn with vertices at A(-4, -1), B(-1, -4), and C(-3, -4).

## Question 2

B. Triangle ABC is rotated through 90° anti-clockwise, centre O. On the diagram, draw and label triangle A"B"C", the image of triangle ABC under this rotation.

[Image: Coordinate grid with triangle ABC]

Figure, described in words:
A Cartesian coordinate grid showing the x-axis and y-axis intersecting at the origin labeled O. The grid extends 5 units to the left, 10 units to the right, 5 units up, and 8 units down. Each grid square represents 1 unit by 1 unit. In the third quadrant, a triangle ABC is drawn with vertices at A(-4, -1), B(-1, -4), and C(-3, -4).

Answer each of the 2 questions.

answer_1.description: Your answer to question 1, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer_1.title: Answer 1

answer_2.description: Your answer to question 2, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer_2.title: Answer 2

output.answer_1: To reflect triangle ABC in the y-axis, I would change the sign of each x-coordinate while keeping the y-coordinates the same. So, A(-4, -1) becomes A' (4, -1), B(-1, -4) becomes B' (1, -4), and C(-3, -4) becomes C' (3, -4).  I would then draw a new triangle A'B'C' on the grid with these vertices. I would draw a line segment connecting A'(4,-1) to B'(1,-4), then a line segment connecting B'(1,-4) to C'(3,-4), and finally a line segment connecting C'(3,-4) to A'(4,-1). I would label the vertices as A', B', and C'.
output.answer_2: To rotate triangle ABC 90° anti-clockwise around the origin O, I would apply the rotation transformation (x, y) -> (-y, x) to each vertex. So, A(-4, -1) becomes A" (1, -4), B(-1, -4) becomes B" (4, -1), and C(-3, -4) becomes C" (4, 3). I would then draw a new triangle A"B"C" on the grid with these vertices. I would draw a line segment connecting A"(1,-4) to B"(4,-1), then a line segment connecting B"(4,-1) to C"(4,3), and finally a line segment connecting C"(4,3) to A"(1,-4). I would label the vertices as A", B", and C".
